$comment: The pre-fetch source allowlist. This file decides what host a CI runner is permitted to
connect to on behalf of a contributor-supplied source_url (threat T-1-07, SSRF).
The EUR-Lex web FRONT END is deliberately ABSENT and must stay absent. It answers every
non-browser request with an accepted-but-empty response — status 202, content-length 0,
x-amzn-waf-action: challenge — across its homepage, the ELI form and the PDF form, on
repeated attempts. That is a standing anti-automation posture, not an outage, so the
retry branch would never succeed and classifying it as unreachable would be wrong: it is
permanently unverifiable by fetch. publications.europa.eu is the substitute and is in the
`all` is permitted for every country. `byCountry` holds the 27 EU member states keyed by
ISO-3166-1 alpha-2. The 22 entries that are empty arrays are the honest starting state,
not a gap: a country gets its national register here only when a maintainer adds it with
evidence. Host matching is exact or a single-label subdomain, on the punycode host.
$comment_linkable: A SECOND, separate list: hosts the site may PRESENT to a worker as an official link.
This is not the same question as `byCountry` and must not be merged into it. `byCountry`
answers 'what host may a CI runner connect to', and widening it to permit a link would
widen the SSRF surface for a reason that has nothing to do with fetching. `linkable`
answers 'what host may we put under the words your equality body', which is a phishing
Every host in `all` or in that country's `byCountry` list is linkable already — a source
we fetch is a source we may cite. `linkable` holds only the additions: a complaint form,
a labour inspectorate, a filing portal, none of which CI ever retrieves.
All 27 are empty today, and that is the honest state rather than a gap: every field this
transposition.national_act.url) is null in all 27 records. A host arrives here the same
way a register does — a maintainer adds it, with evidence, in a reviewed diff, rather
than it arriving unnoticed inside a 600-line country record.
discovery_hints[].national_link is deliberately NOT governed by this list. Those links
are harvested verbatim from the Commission's own register, their provenance IS that
register, and the 7 hosts they name today are national registers nobody has curated.
They are held to scheme hygiene only. See HARVESTED_POLICY in schema.ts.
